Independent direct GDAL and brute-feature tests verify representative answers. Compare full identity/qualification envelopes, not counts.

semantics.crs: EPSG2056 and EPSG4326/OGC:CRS84 only, always_xy2D. Densify rectangle edges32steps for transformed query boundaries; explicit operation approximation/accuracy. No vertical conversions.
semantics.feature: source-scoped exact identity; optional actual parent association. No global equivalence or inventory absence claim.
semantics.qualification: full raw native record or raster header, semantic context/claim/definitions/resources, relevant source/preparation rights, unknowns, time, membership/selection and stable identities retained
semantics.spatial: point covers native vector geometry; bounded area positive-area intersection. Queries clipped to closed4km2 applicability core, not source geometry. Raster points use native affine half-open row/column lookup; areas return exact intersecting support plus conservative native window candidates. WC area reports native cell-centre classification counts with exact transformed-query mask, not fractions. Height area returns selection descriptor, not invented aggregate.
semantics.time: evidence-epoch inclusive calendar-year range over known source nominal/survey references; unknown evidence excluded unless explicitly requested. Product-reference years carry distinct release/distribution basis. No exact-date interpolation or change detection.

stop: Measured adequate standalone organisation and integration readiness; do not register/publish or start optimisation/infrastructure.
uncertainty: Can selective real native support/feature/epoch retrieval preserve exact qualified answers with practical regional organisation?
